module: Flowgraph node "Rally Loop Get Info" (category once_instant, tag rally). Reads from the rally loop manager the name of the rally (rm:getRallyLoopName()) and the start and end screen texts of the mission (missionTypeData.startScreenText / endScreenText, "" by default). Outputs: name, startScreenText, endScreenText (string or translationObject table).

workOnce.desc: Writes name, startScreenText and endScreenText; error log if there is no manager.
